★Request
Heart clinks glasses in time with dialogue

I'm excited!
Why, you're practically a real secret agent now!

Feel free to take a break.
—Thank you for working so hard for me!

"From posture alone, Person A has athletic training. Highly skilled.
Unlikely to blend in as an ordinary civilian."

...To be honest, I'm not very good in front of crowds.
Still, as Dearing Heart's Trainer...

If it follows the usual schedule, next up is dance time.
I'm heading out, but please go take a rest...
(Woooo! Woooo!)

Once we change into our "spy" outfits at the venue,
the excitement will blow it all away! ...We're fine!

And for that, I want to share even more moments with you.
I want us to experience so much more together—don't you think so?

This is unbelievable!
Incredible, Trainer! Every single one is spot-on!
Wait, is this an analysis of all the guests?

—Wow.
Looks like quite the adorable little mouse snuck in.

Today, I really got to know you.
Both how sharp your analysis is, and how you push yourself too hard.

...It's even livelier than I imagined, making me worry if I can keep up.
I want to do my best so as not to embarrass Heart, but...

Didn't I tell you when I invited you?
My goal for today is "mutual understanding."
Wow.

Count me in, of course! 
What about you, Trainer? Gonna join in? Are you, are you?!

Oh honestly, you can be so dense about the strangest things!
I want you to look at me much more closely with those inquisitive eyes of yours.

After all, aren't we buddies who will blaze through
the Twinkle Series together?

So, keep your eyes on me, okay?
You know what I mean.

Well, fair enough. ...Still, don't worry!
After all, today is a "theme party"!

—No.
I appreciate the sentiment, but no thanks, Trainer.
—Now then...

Person A is that girl in the one-piece dress, right?
She's actually a black belt in judo!

Still, that took a heavy toll on both my energy and stamina.
I'd like to spend some quiet time for a bit, but...

Hey, what about the others? If you don't mind, show me the rest of your analysis!
Let's check the answers together!

If I'm going to make it as her Trainer,
I need to keep up with this kind of energy...

Hehe, did you find your answer?
Well then, let's see how you did! My brilliant secret agent♪

Non. I'm feeling a bit tired, so I'll go take a rest.
See you in a bit.

Oh, hey Heart! Is that the rumored Trainer next to you?
Nice to meetcha~! Cheers to that☆

The "Best Agent Look Contest."
Basically a disguise contest, right?

...Inside the house, I think you'll be able to relax quietly.
You can keep an eye on things out here from there, too.
Did you analyze them just by observing?

Good evening, everyone.
As a token of our new acquaintance, allow me to play a piece for you.

Seeing her charming wink melted away the guilt in my chest.
Before I knew it, a natural smile formed on my face.

I need to know more about you,
and you need to know more about me.

At first, I was just watching from afar... but as I observed them,
it seems my professional instincts took over without me realizing.
Kyaa~! So cool~♡

And Person B is that girl, right? She's an absolute spy movie fanatic,
she even cosplays on a regular basis.
Nervous?

Hehe, a "hotelier"!
Quite unexpected and clever, wouldn't you say?

As my nervousness hit its peak, a calm voice in the back of my mind spoke.
..."If you're going to fall anyway, might as well fall forward."
I'm entering, but what about you girls?

The mission for our agent is—"A sensationally popular top idol"!
Whenever you're ready!

My goal is to understand you.
Forcing you to keep up just to have fun together completely misses the point.
I'm shook.

Wait, you can't even play at all?! ...And moving on, next up!
Our next agent is that fine lady's Trainer!

What?
Aren't you exhausted, though?

...Oh, my gosh. You are an eager beaver.
You really do push yourself so hard.

Checkmate—just kidding! Sorry to keep you waiting, Trainer!
Oh! Look at you, a picture-perfect "office worker undercover spy"♪

It's a game where you use provided costumes and props
to disguise yourself to match your "mission"!

"Person B's outfit is elaborate. A perfectionist, or perhaps
has deep knowledge of the genre. Could serve as a conversation starter."

Ah, there you are.
...Wait—Hmm?

Hello everyone! Now that everyone's gathered,
we'll be kicking off the Best Agent Look Contest!

While listening to the distant hustle and bustle outside,
I found myself staring down at my notebook, when...

Next up! The mission for Agent Dearing Heart is...
"Sheltered Highborn Lady"!

And so came the day of the party she invited me to.
Carrying the costumes on my way to the venue...

Fancy that! Who knew you had that in you?
Everyone was absolutely thrilled.
Even though she had said that...

Oh, you changed, Heart.
Where are you off to? Restroom?
(Scrrreeeech...)
